intendedObjective: Condense the meeting report into a usable account of proposals and next steps.
acceptableEditScope: Reorganize and simplify while distinguishing proposals, tentative arrangements, agreed tasks, and absent commitments.
stableFactsAndClaims: The May 21 meeting involved five archive volunteers and two town history group members; it generated proposals without spending decisions.
The photograph index is currently searchable only in the reading room; the history group proposed an online copy.
Donor personal contact details must be removed before index publication.
Opening is Tuesday afternoons and the first Saturday morning monthly; two volunteers offered Thursday coverage, but no rota was established and two people must be present.
The coordinator will ask remaining volunteers about regular Thursday availability.
Unlisted newspaper cutting boxes prompted a proposal to record dates and visible headlines without unfolding fragile pages; this does not replace conservation or authorize unrestricted use.
The coordinator will identify publishable fields, gather availability, and estimate listing time for June review.
There is no public launch date, purchase approval, or promised summer opening session.
requiredForm: Concise meeting report focused on proposals and next steps.
ambiguity: Online publication, Thursday opening, and cutting listing remain proposals subject to further information.
voiceConstraints: Plain, concise, administratively precise about status.
